en.headline: An Animal Crossing Leaf Edition 512GB microSD card, officially licensed for Nintendo Switch and Switch Lite
en.intro: This SanDisk 512GB microSDXC card is officially licensed for the Nintendo Switch and Switch Lite and adds up to 512GB for downloaded games, screenshots and video captures. Our concierge checked the model, variant, stock and price before listing; after you order, FeelBetter buys it from the seller in the United States and ships it to Korea, typically in 7–14 business days.
highlights: It is officially licensed for the Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch Lite systems.
Read speeds of up to 100MB/s and write speeds of up to 90MB/s mean less waiting and more playing.
It instantly adds up to 512GB of storage to your system.
Downloaded games, screenshots and video captures can live in one place, so you can travel light.
It is a UHS-I, Class 10 microSDXC card in the green Animal Crossing Leaf Edition.

sections.p: This card works with the Nintendo Switch and Switch Lite, and it is not designed for the Nintendo Switch 2. For the Switch 2, the listing points to a separate SanDisk microSD Express card, so please choose another card if you own that console.

The card is a 512 GB microSDXC UHS-I, Class 10 model (SDSQXAO-512G-GNCZN). Speeds of up to 100MB/s read and 90MB/s write are based on internal testing noted in the listing, so real results can be lower depending on the device and conditions. The listing also names it as temperature proof, water proof and X-ray proof.

cautions: Not compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2; it is made for the Switch and Switch Lite.
The listed capacity counts 1GB as 1,000,000,000 bytes, so the storage you can actually use is less.
